summary: Curaleaf Holdings filed an 8-K on September 8, 2026, attaching a fact sheet responding to what it calls misleading statements by Aurora Cannabis regarding Curaleaf's proposal to acquire Aurora. Curaleaf claims a 45% premium, or 110% excluding Aurora's cash, among the highest Canadian M&A premiums of the past decade. The filing is a Rule 425 written communication, signaling an active, contested deal solicitation. No price per share, expected close, advisor, or break fee is stated. Watch for Aurora's board response and any formal offer terms or regulatory review timeline.
